items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed via Pause > Controls; Esc opens pause menu with Continue ~(0.315,0.58), Controls ~0.43, Settings ~0.55, Save&Quit ~0.68): WASD move, mouse left/right click, Left Alt inspect, Left Ctrl attack, F attack, Space action, Q/E rotate, wheel zoom, Tab map, Esc pause, number keys trigger the matching hotbar slot's native action (confirmed: pressing the slot key ate a berry). Open Crafting is Caps Lock and could not be triggered with allowed keys. Pause/Controls panels close via their buttons.

CRAFTING UI (verified repeatedly): left vertical column is the crafting bar; category icon centers sit at the very left edge x≈0.028 (Tools/axe ≈y0.10-0.14, Light/flame ≈y0.19-0.20, rope ≈y0.25). Clicking a category opens a recipe plaque column at x≈0.10; plaques stack ~0.06-0.11 apart vertically but their positions DRIFT between openings — always hover and verify the card title before building. Hovering a plaque shows a recipe card with have/need counts and a Build button at ~x0.27-0.29, y≈0.66-0.68; Build is greyed when short. Clicking Build crafts and closes the panel. C/Space/Enter never craft. Torch recipe confirmed = 2 grass + 2 twigs; crafted torch equips in a hotbar slot at 100% durability and burns ~2 minutes (~3-4% per action step). Campfire recipe observed = 3 grass + 2 logs (logs never obtained; Build always grey). In the Light tab the torch plaque is the gold diagonal stick-with-flame icon, usually below the dark campfire silhouettes; hovering other rows can open the Fire Pit/Campfire cards instead.

RESOURCE MECHANICS (verified): clicks on distant plants are two-stage — first click walks, second click picks; chase the sprite as the camera moves. Hover precise sprite pixels for tooltips. 'Pick Grass' = fresh grass tuft (tall spiky pale-yellow cluster; often near evergreen bases, also on savanna/open ground); 'Examine Grass' = already harvested (short dull yellow stub). Yellow slivers beside evergreen trunks are sometimes part of the tree sprite (no tooltip, untargetable) or harvested tufts. 'Pick Sapling' = small bare twiggy bush, yields 1 twig; 'Examine Sapling' = harvested. Curved sticks lying on the ground are harvested stumps, never pickups (learned via many false assumptions). Tall spindly bare trees are evergreens ('Examine Evergreen'), not saplings. 'Pick Berry Bush' (ripe bushes show red dots) yields 1 berry; harvested bushes show 'Examine Berry Bush' and messages suggest they regrow. One berry restores only a little hunger — eat early and often; hunger warnings ('I'm so hungry!') precede starvation. Flowers pick into petals ('Pick Flower'). Mushrooms seen but untested (edibility unknown). Fireflies are untargetable; butterflies, crows, cardinals are not resources. Clicking where a creature overlaps can trigger an attack instead ('That'll teach him.' message).

DANGERS (observed): Day 1 dusk message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.'; historically full darkness produced 'What was that?!' then 'OW! Something hit me!' with red vignette and rapid health loss. However in this session two nights passed with full HP and no damage, so darkness damage appears sporadic/conditional rather than guaranteed — uncertain. Spiders are hostile, bite and pursue, and caused a persistent red damage tint; fleeing (walking away) works better than fighting unarmed. Red hounds appear at night. Crafting still works in darkness after the torch expires ('My light just ran out!'), which repeatedly saved the run. Character can hide behind tree canopies; approach targets from a side where the sprite is exposed, and aim just past canopy edges because trunks/canopies intercept pointers.

NAVIGATION/BIOMES: Map (Tab) shows only a small explored patch; rest black. Spawn/forest area (center) was heavily picked clean of saplings and tufts. Savanna lies north (grass tufts, boulders, few saplings). Rocky biome to the east; sandy/desert with rabbit burrows further east; ocean-like edge far south; a boulder cliff area with spiders somewhere along the way. Green forest with evergreens is the most reliable sapling habitat; fresh saplings and tall tufts kept appearing at biome edges and in unvisited turf. Cardinal/reeds stand near boundaries.

FAILED STRATEGIES LESSONS: clicking crafting icons too far right; assuming ground sticks were pickups; hunting twigs after nightfall instead of securing materials in daylight; wandering while the torch burned down instead of gathering the 2+2 buffer; attacking spiders bare-handed; trusting short yellow stubs at evergreen bases as fresh grass. Twigs were consistently the bottleneck — saplings are sparse near spawn, so harvest every 'Pick Sapling' immediately and keep 2 twigs banked.

SURVIVAL PRIORITIES LEARNED: maintain a standing buffer of 2 grass + 2 twigs (torch recipe) and craft a new torch once the current one drops below ~20-25%; harvesting/picking works in the dark so materials carried over between torch deaths; eat berries as soon as hunger warnings start (one berry is not enough); avoid spiders/hounds; verify recipe cards and inventory counts by hovering rather than guessing icon counts.

UNRESOLVED/UNCERTAIN: exact mechanics of night damage (sporadic vs. delayed); mushroom edibility; whether harvested berry bushes regrow and how fast; whether logs can be obtained (needed for Campfire); some hotbar icons (axe-like/tool-like) were unidentified; fireflies likely require a net; purpose of flowers/petals and rabbits unknown.
